name: Jotform
oneLiner: No-code online form and survey builder with templates, QR codes, payments, tables, apps, e-signatures and, since 2025-2026, AI agents and conversational AI form building.
bestFor: Restaurants that want an affordable, flexible tool for guest feedback surveys, catering and event inquiries, job applications and internal checklists in one place, and don't need built-in NPS benchmarking or location comparisons.

updates.text: Launched Jotform AI Agents, no-code AI agents that answer questions and help fill forms across web chat, phone and messaging channels.
Launched Jotform AI, which builds, designs and edits forms from written or spoken prompts, followed a week later by a Jotform app in ChatGPT for creating forms and querying responses.
Announced AI App Builder for creating complete apps from natural-language prompts.

features: Drag-and-drop form and survey builder with thousands of templates, including restaurant feedback surveys
QR codes and links for receipts, menus and table tents so guests answer on their phones
Conditional logic that shows or hides questions based on earlier answers
Report Builder and Jotform Tables to turn responses into charts and spreadsheet views
Payments through Stripe, PayPal, Square and others for deposits and orders
Jotform AI to create forms from a prompt, and AI Agents to answer guest questions
Jotform Apps, Workflows approvals and Sign for e-signatures
Integrations with Google Sheets, Salesforce, HubSpot, Mailchimp, Slack and Zapier

pricing.text: Free Starter plan: 5 forms, 100 submissions per month. Paid plans per month billed annually: Bronze $34, Silver $39, Gold $99 ($39 / $49 / $129 billed monthly). Enterprise is quoted. 50% off for nonprofits and education.
